body:
Ostgosh
CR 1

The large bird raises its head, sensing your approach. It seems to be trying to determine whether to run or to attack.

XP 400
N Large animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 9 (+4 Dex, –1 size)
hp 15 (2d8+6)
Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee 2 talons +5 (1d4+2)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 2, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +1; CMB +5; CMD 17
Feats Endurance, Run
Skills Perception +6
SQ Rushing Limits

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Rushing Limits (Ex)

The creature is capable of breaking past it’s limits with the help of a skilled enough rider. As a swift action, a creature mounting a creature with this feature may make a modified Spur Mount check, as per the ride skill. In addition to the base movement speed added by the skill use, for every five points by which the skill check exceeds the DC 15, the mount gains an additional 10-foot bonus to it’s movement speed. This use of this ability may only be used once a day.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate plains
Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3–30)
Treasure none

Ostgosh are a large bird creature, with two strong legs.

Their feathers are of various colors that show some of their extraordinary ability, but the vast majority of them are bright yellow.
